description: A client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft that hides all HUD elements when looking through a spyglass, leaving only the spyglass overlay visible for a clean, immersive viewing experience.

mods.name: Spyglass Only HUD
mods.description: Hides all HUD elements (hotbar, health, crosshair, etc.) when using a spyglass, leaving only the spyglass overlay visible.
